metadata.experiment: E3 candidate-set size and composition sensitivity
metadata.composition_note: The corpus records declarations, not sales. Uniform row sampling already weights a supplier by publication volume; supplier_equal removes that weighting and local restricts the pool to a few suppliers. None of the three is a market-share simulation.
metadata.sensitivity_interval_note: Percentiles summarize split/fold sensitivity on one corpus; they are not independent-data confidence intervals.
